joining_perks: First year membership fee: Your first-year membership fee will be waived off if your total spends cross Rs.50,000 within the first 30 days of your card being set up date.
reward_structure:
- You earn 9 YES Rewards Points for every Rs.200 spent on online shopping excluding select categories.
- For offline shopping you can earn 9 YES Rewards Points for every Rs.200 spent, again excluding select categories.
- On select categories, you earn 2 YES Rewards Points for every Rs.200 spent.
- Reward points can also be converted into movie tickets, YES Rewards Points equals to 1 Citi Thank You Point.
key_highlights:
- Enjoy fuel surcharge waiver at all fuel pumps across the country.
- Earn reward points on your spends and redeem them through YES Rewards.
- Benefits from preferential foreign currency markup rate of just 2.5%.
- Includes insurance cover for enhanced safety while shopping.
- Access premium insurance benefits for online & offline transactions

benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Fuel Surcharge Waiver: Get 2% instant surcharge waiver at all fuel stations in India for transactions between Rs.400 & Rs.5,000.
benefits_features.Credit Card insurance: Credit Shield Cover: Get credit shield cover in the case of accidental death of the primary cardholder. The insurance coverage includes: Credit Shield Cover of Rs.1 Lakh and loss/liability cover of Rs.3 Lakh.
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: Renewal Membership Fee Reversal: The renewal membership fee will be reversed for the total spends of Rs.3,00,000 in previous year.

how_tos.How do I generate my password for online: To generate an IVR password, please contact our YES bank customer care with the last 4 digits of your YES Bank Credit Card number in 9122708011 from your registered mobile number.
how_tos.What should I suspect if I find my trans: If you suspect fraud or suspect any fraudulent activities visit YES Bank app or customer support. Review your transaction for any unusual charges and report suspicious activity immediately to resolve it right away. Always keep your card details and security responding to unsolicited messages or calls.
how_tos.How do I keep my YES Bank ACE Credit Car: To protect your card use contactless payments, keep your PIN, passwords, and CVV confidential, and avoid sharing them. Rapidly check your transactions and check your card immediately if YES Bank app or any suspicious activity.

miscellaneous:
Eligibility Criteria for YES Bank ACE Credit Card:
To be eligible to get a YES Bank ACE Credit Card, you need to meet the following eligibility criteria:
- You should be minimum 21 years.
- You should not be over 60 years.
- You should be salaried individuals or self-employed.
- Your minimum net monthly salary should be Rs.25,000.
- If you are self-employed, your Income Tax Returns should be Rs.3.5 Lakh or more.

faqs.Is YES Bank ACE Credit Card contactless: Yes. This is a contactless credit card.
